hints.title: Alphabet Feasibility Check
hints.text: Every character present in target must occur at least once in source. If any character in target is missing from source, forming target is impossible.

hints.title: Greedy Subsequence Consumption
hints.text: Each pass through source should match as many characters of target in order as possible. Advancing greedily through source minimizes the total passes needed.

hints.title: Pass Counting
hints.text: Maintain target pointer j. Loop through source matching characters against target[j]. When reaching source end, increment subsequence count. Repeat until target is consumed.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking arbitrary partitions without greedy subsequence matching produces sub-optimal or exponential search paths.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Greedy sequential matching takes O(S * T) worst case and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should check character set presence and use greedy two-pointer subsequence matching.
complexity.notes: Can also be optimized to O(T log S) using binary search on character index lists in source.
